items.headline: Oracle force majeure notice on New Mexico data center to weigh on data center debt, Morgan Stanley says
items.note: Oracle's notice puts loan and lease documents for roughly $18B of loans tied to the leased site under scrutiny, which could complicate other data-center financings.

items.headline: Could AI data centre financing become a systemic risk?
items.note: Analyst commentary on contagion risk from concentrated AI data-center debt; it describes no realized credit event.
